en.hubeali: H 14729 – Sahl, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from yunus, from Abdul A’ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Statement of Allahazwj: “[24:63] therefore let those beware who go against his order lest a trial afflict them or there befall them a painful chastisement”.
Imam<sup>asws</sup> said: (it’s) ‘فِتْنَةٌ’ Strife in His<sup>azwj</sup> Religion or oppression for which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> does not Reward’.
en.sarwar: 281. Sahl, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from yunus, from Abdul A’ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (a.s.) about the Statement of Allah (azwj): “[24:63] therefore let those beware who go against his order lest a trial afflict them or there befall them a painful chastisement”.
Imam (a.s.) said: (it’s) ‘فِتْنَةٌ’ Strife in His (azwj) Religion or oppression for which Allah (azwj) does not Reward’.
